WITH per AS (SELECT 'LY' yr, DATE '2025-07-28' s, DATE '2025-08-24' e UNION ALL SELECT 'TY', DATE '2026-08-03', DATE '2026-08-30'),
fs AS (SELECT p.yr, st.store_id, sum(f.net_amount) fact_all, sum(CASE WHEN f.staff_purchase_flag THEN 0 ELSE f.net_amount END) fact_nostaff, sum(CASE WHEN f.staff_purchase_flag THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END) staff
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN per p ON f.sale_date BETWEEN p.s AND p.e JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=f.store_key WHERE st.store_id<900 GROUP BY 1,2),
rp AS (SELECT p.yr, r.store_id, sum(r.net_sales_before_returns) rpt_gross, sum(r.returns_net) rpt_ret, sum(r.net_sales) rpt_net FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN per p ON r.business_date BETWEEN p.s AND p.e GROUP BY 1,2)
SELECT fs.yr, count(*) stores, sum(fact_all) fact_all, sum(fact_nostaff) fact_nostaff, sum(staff) staff, sum(rpt_gross) rpt_gross, sum(rpt_ret) rpt_ret, sum(rpt_net) rpt_net
FROM fs LEFT JOIN rp ON rp.yr=fs.yr AND rp.store_id=fs.store_id GROUP BY 1

WITH per AS (SELECT 'LY' yr, DATE '2025-07-28' s, DATE '2025-08-24' e UNION ALL SELECT 'TY', DATE '2026-08-03', DATE '2026-08-30')
SELECT 'sales' AS src, p.yr, st.store_id<900 AS real_store, coalesce(f.channel_id,-1) AS ch, count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS d, sum(f.net_amount) AS amt
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN per p ON f.sale_date BETWEEN p.s AND p.e JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=f.store_key GROUP BY ALL
UNION ALL
SELECT 'returns', p.yr, st.store_id<900, coalesce(sf.channel_id,-1), count(*), count(DISTINCT r.return_line_id), sum(r.refund_net)
FROM fact_return_line r JOIN per p ON r.return_date BETWEEN p.s AND p.e JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=r.store_key LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line sf ON sf.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY 1,2,3,4

WITH per AS (SELECT 'LY' yr, DATE '2025-07-28' s, DATE '2025-08-24' e UNION ALL SELECT 'TY', DATE '2026-08-03', DATE '2026-08-30'),
lfl AS (SELECT DISTINCT store_id, store_name FROM dim_store WHERE is_current AND store_id < 900 AND close_date IS NULL AND (open_date IS NULL OR open_date <= DATE '2024-07-28')
  AND store_id NOT IN (SELECT store_id FROM ref_store_closure WHERE closure_start_date <= DATE '2026-08-30' AND closure_end_date >= DATE '2025-07-28')),
sales AS (SELECT p.yr, st.store_id, sum(f.net_amount) amt FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN per p ON f.sale_date BETWEEN p.s AND p.e JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=f.store_key
  WHERE coalesce(f.channel_code,'ST')<>'WB' AND coalesce(f.channel_id,1)=1 GROUP BY 1,2),
rets AS (SELECT p.yr, st.store_id, sum(r.refund_net) amt FROM fact_return_line r JOIN per p ON r.return_date BETWEEN p.s AND p.e JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=r.store_key
  JOIN fact_sales_line sf ON sf.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id WHERE coalesce(sf.channel_code,'ST')<>'WB' AND coalesce(sf.channel_id,1)=1 GROUP BY 1,2),
net AS (SELECT l.store_id, l.store_name, p.yr, coalesce(s.amt,0)-coalesce(r.amt,0) AS net_sales FROM lfl l CROSS JOIN per p
  LEFT JOIN sales s ON s.store_id=l.store_id AND s.yr=p.yr LEFT JOIN rets r ON r.store_id=l.store_id AND r.yr=p.yr)
SELECT coalesce(CAST(store_id AS VARCHAR),'TOTAL') AS sid, any_value(store_name) AS nm, sum(CASE WHEN yr='TY' THEN net_sales END) AS ty, sum(CASE WHEN yr='LY' THEN net_sales END) AS ly,
 round(100.0*(sum(CASE WHEN yr='TY' THEN net_sales END)/sum(CASE WHEN yr='LY' THEN net_sales END)-1),2) AS gr
FROM net GROUP BY ROLLUP(store_id) ORDER BY store_id

WITH per AS (SELECT 'LY' yr, DATE '2025-07-28' s, DATE '2025-08-24' e UNION ALL SELECT 'TY', DATE '2026-08-03', DATE '2026-08-30'),
cand AS (SELECT DISTINCT store_id, store_name, open_date, close_date FROM dim_store WHERE is_current AND store_id < 900),
sales AS (SELECT p.yr, st.store_id, sum(f.net_amount) amt FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN per p ON f.sale_date BETWEEN p.s AND p.e JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=f.store_key
  WHERE coalesce(f.channel_code,'ST')<>'WB' AND coalesce(f.channel_id,1)=1 GROUP BY 1,2),
rets AS (SELECT p.yr, st.store_id, sum(r.refund_net) amt FROM fact_return_line r JOIN per p ON r.return_date BETWEEN p.s AND p.e JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=r.store_key
  JOIN fact_sales_line sf ON sf.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id WHERE coalesce(sf.channel_code,'ST')<>'WB' AND coalesce(sf.channel_id,1)=1 GROUP BY 1,2),
net AS (SELECT c.store_id, c.store_name, c.open_date, c.close_date, p.yr, coalesce(s.amt,0)-coalesce(r.amt,0) AS net_sales FROM cand c CROSS JOIN per p
  LEFT JOIN sales s ON s.store_id=c.store_id AND s.yr=p.yr LEFT JOIN rets r ON r.store_id=c.store_id AND r.yr=p.yr),
v AS (
 SELECT 'main' AS variant, * FROM net WHERE close_date IS NULL AND (open_date IS NULL OR open_date <= DATE '2024-07-28')
 UNION ALL SELECT 'excl_refits', * FROM net WHERE close_date IS NULL AND (open_date IS NULL OR open_date <= DATE '2024-07-28') AND store_id NOT IN (119,125)
 UNION ALL SELECT 'incl_new', * FROM net WHERE close_date IS NULL
)
SELECT variant, 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 4 AS fiscal_period, count(DISTINCT store_id) AS n_stores, round(sum(CASE WHEN yr='TY' THEN net_sales END),2) AS ty, round(sum(CASE WHEN yr='LY' THEN net_sales END),2) AS ly,
 round(100.0*(sum(CASE WHEN yr='TY' THEN net_sales END)/sum(CASE WHEN yr='LY' THEN net_sales END)-1),2) AS lfl_net_sales_growth_pct
FROM v GROUP BY variant ORDER BY variant
